description: The Remove Duplicates dialog. Lists every column in the range with a checkbox, offers a "my data has headers" toggle (which switches the column labels between header text and the column letter), select-all / deselect-all helpers and a case-sensitivity option. Applying yields a . All text is localized.

parameters.name: OnApply
parameters.description: Header text per absolute column index, used to label columns when my data has headers is on. Columns without an entry fall back to their column letter.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the user applies the dialog.
